description: This source file defines the InsertionListView class, a custom Android ListView that supports animated insertion of new rows and visual effects, including animations of list items and image pop-ins. It manages data set modifications, visual transitions, and drawing of temporary bitmaps during animations.

classes.name: InsertionListView
classes.description: A custom ListView subclass for animated insertion of new row items with visual effects.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a new ListItemObject at the top of the list and performs complex animations to visually insert it.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the underlying data list that the ListView displays.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Assigns the parent RelativeLayout needed for overlay animations.

methods.name: setRowAdditionAnimationListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to receive callbacks at the start and end of row addition animations.

methods.name: shouldAnimateInNewRow
methods.description: Determines if the insertion animation for a new row should occur, typically if the list is scrolled to the top.

methods.name: shouldAnimateInNewImage
methods.description: Determines if an image pop-in animation should occur with the new row.

methods.name: getBitmapDrawableFromView
methods.description: Creates and returns a BitmapDrawable of the current visual state of a View.

methods.name: getLocationOnScreen
methods.description: Returns the absolute screen coordinates of a View.
